problem: The red IN at the start flags is billboarded and huge. It sits in the sky over the approach, bigger than the fence.
likely cause: course.gd _gate_line Label3D font_size 68 with no pixel_size
fix idea: Set pixel_size so the letters sit on the flags. Do the same for OUT.
verdict: better: the letters sit by the rail instead of filling the sky

problem: On the jump the camera climbs and crops the horse. The landing is a view of the rails with the horse cut off at the top.
fix idea: Keep the ears and the fence in frame. Stop the pop from takeoff to landing.

problem: Abbott's face photo is smeared in brown streaks down the white face. The ear is a jagged stub.
fix idea: One projection pass if the streaks are a UV bug. If the mesh cannot hold the photo
status: stop and leave it for Ernie.

problem: Madison's lower legs stick straight out to the side. They do not hang on the horse.
fix idea: Do not nudge the pose. This needs a real rig.

problem: The shadow under the horse is a soft blob off to the left. The legs cast almost nothing, so he looks like he is floating.
fix idea: Drop the extra oval or seat one shadow on the hooves.

problem: Blue-gray specks hang in the air under the belly and at the hooves.
A hard vertical seam splits the sky into two brightnesses. The same bright band shows at the left of the head shot.
fix idea: The texture file stays. Rotate the panorama or use the procedural sky so the seam is not in the ride view.

problem: Paused is drawn on top of the scoreboard. The lines collide. Round complete does the same thing.
fix idea: Hide the scoreboard while a menu is open
status: or move the menu off that corner.

problem: From the ride camera the next fence is a small mark in a wide field of sand. The ears are in frame. The fence is hard to read.
fix idea: Bring the lens in on the approach so the ears and the next fence are both easy to see.

problem: The yellow wing is a flat card with no cloth. The flowers are green squares on sticks. The jump reads as a pile of blocks.
fix idea: A material pass on the wing and the fill. No new props.

problem: Trees are black poles with orange discs. From the ride camera they read as lollipops, and each shadow is a perfect circle on the grass.
fix idea: A small scale and material try only. New tree models are Ernie's call.

problem: The sun blows the right side of the sky to pure white. The clouds lose their shape there.
fix idea: Lower the sun and the exposure so the sky keeps detail. Warm late afternoon

problem: The bridle is thick black rods that float off the face and do not meet the bit.
fix idea: Pull the rods onto the head so they meet the bit.

problem: The scoreboard type is small and gray. Fence 1 of 3 is hard to read on the dark panel.
fix idea: Larger type and more contrast. Same words.

problem: HIDDEN K SCHOOLING is a giant banner through the trees beside the rail.
fix idea: Same pixel_size fix as the IN letters
status: so it reads as a rail sign.
